ActorTalk: This creature really lives in the ocean? With a body that huge, imagine how much water it has to push aside just to move...
That must be... it must be...
Even as an artistic projection, you can still sense the grace of such a remarkable creature.
You've never seen a whale before?
I rarely go on surface missions, let alone to the ocean. I've only seen them in old archival footage.
This is the first time I've seen one moving so close to me. I don't know why... but it feels a little lonely.
I guess everyone reacts differently when faced with a life so unlike our own.
That's true. Everyone brings their own experiences with them.
What about you? Did it feel different to you when you saw it?
Of course. That's just my story.
In a way, it acts as a medium for thought.
Whether you look at it through nature, psychology, or philosophy, it keeps asking questions about life, loneliness, and death.
